## 2026-11-12T16:05Z Client revision branch alias

- The client revision applied its copy change and deployed successfully at a deployment hash URL, but the branch alias stayed 404 and the workflow failed before sending the developer preview.
- `SAFE_REQUEST` truncated a UUID to 24 characters, which left a trailing hyphen. A Cloudflare Pages branch alias is a DNS label, so `review-client-revision-2428ef16-47a7-4fea-8fe4-.project.pages.dev` can never resolve.
- The token now strips leading and trailing hyphens after truncation and rejects any remaining non-DNS character. Regression test added.

## 2026-11-12T18:55Z Real end-to-end verification of the claim and contrast fixes

Ran intake 83 (`43268593738`) on `11f2d237` to test the shipped fixes against a live launch.

### Verified fixed

- Copy generation cleared for the first time on this intake. The availability false positives are gone. The run reached the reference-analysis, authoring and preview-build stages, which it had never done before.
- The white-on-light-paper contrast class is gone from the rendered gate output. The `[class*="__contact"]` regression fix and the FAQ marker change both hold.

### Two further blockers found

- Creative render refused the run: `code authoring on OpenCode Go must use deepseek-v4.1-flash; refused openai/gpt-6-luna`. The render CLI resolved `creativeSession.creativeModel` into its `model` argument, which the resolver treats as an explicit request, so a stale saved session still outranked the environment pin. Fixed at `af46d3cd`: the CLI forwards only an explicit `--model` flag. Deploy `43283579806` succeeded.
- The pack fallback then failed rendered verification on focus rings only, for example `focus "a" (1.000; required 3); foreground #bd552d, background variable; text paint is indistinguishable from its rendered backdrop`. These are focus indicators whose outline colour resolves to the same colour as the surface behind them. Not yet fixed.

### Honest status

- 18/20 is not demonstrated. The claim guard and the dominant contrast class are fixed and evidenced; the creative render path and the focus-ring contrast class are not yet proven on a live launch.

## 2026-11-12T20:35Z Focus-ring contrast class fixed; one text pair left

Run `43288778926` on `6e8dcba8` is the first live launch where the focus-ring failures are gone.

- Root cause: a ring with a positive `outline-offset` paints entirely outside the border box, so an element screenshot never contains it. The checker hides the ring and compares captures; with the ring already out of frame the delta was zero, so a clearly visible ring scored 1.000 "indistinguishable from its rendered backdrop".
- Fixed at `6e8dcba8`: capture the ring's own padded band (offset + width + 5px clear per side so the 4px backdrop band cannot sample the ring). Inset rings keep the element capture. Two geometry assertions pin it: an element capture is provably blind to an outset ring (delta 0), the padded band detects it (delta > 50). 63 tests and `npm run check` clean; deploy `43288349200` verified.
- Measured on the live run: the failure list dropped from dozens of focus rings to three findings, all one text pair on `/contact/`: `#6b716d` on `#ece7dc` at 4.047 against a 4.5 minimum.
- That exact pair is already handled by `ensureContrast` in `flat-contrast-repair.mjs` (repairs to `#646966`, 4.536), but `verify-rendered-revision.mjs` only audits and never runs the repair. The contact paragraph resolves `--muted` from the page surface rather than the contact band it is painted on.
- Authoring on this run also failed for a provider reason, not a code one: `OpenCode Go incomplete for route route-01 stage styles: request failed`, after ~51 minutes of authoring.

## 2026-11-12T21:12Z Contrast closed; provider quota blocks execution

### Shipped and verified

- `d7577c01` — muted copy is now proved against the darkest recurring light band on light pages, mirroring the existing accent policy. The exact #83 pair `#6b716d` on `#ece7dc` (4.047) now resolves to `#616663` (4.745 on the contact band, 5.414 on the page). A dark page keeps the page-surface repair, since forcing the token toward a light band would make body copy unreadable on its own canvas. Deploy `43303882979` verified.
- `4f7fb150` — site-copy retries now back off exponentially and give a rate limit a 30s-per-attempt floor. Previously 2s and 4s burned all three attempts during a throttle. Deploy `43305914062` verified.
- Combined with `6e8dcba8` (focus-ring band capture), the three contrast classes that blocked runs 146 and 278 are all fixed at source, with regression tests.

### Provider quota is now the hard blocker

Run `43306301221` failed in intake with `rate-limit` / `http_status=429` on every attempt: two retries at 30s and 60s, then the outer high-effort retry also 429ed across ~3.5 minutes. Run `43304427376` failed the same way earlier. This matches the provider's own billing message returned to the delegated subagents: the organization has used its full rolling 7-day input allowance, with capacity freeing up on 2026-11-18 20:00 UTC unless credits are added.

No code change can clear this. Remaining work is blocked until quota is restored or the provider is switched:
- the end-to-end #83 preview (contrast is fixed, intake never got past copy)
- the 20-intake cohort and the 18/20 measurement
- the `styles` stage failure seen in run `43288778926` (`OpenCode Go incomplete ... request failed` after max/medium/low at ~6 minutes each)

## 2026-11-12T22:30Z First real preview delivered; contrast closed

Run `43315165917` on `1179deb8` delivered the first real preview from this workstream: `https://review-initial.launchloom-83-apex-air-conditioning-hea.pages.dev` (HTTP 200, creative marker present, zero em dashes, rendered verification passed). The developer email was accepted (`email_id=01a1d1dc-...`) and the handoff was marked complete.

### Contrast is now fully closed

Three successive live runs narrowed the rendered-gate failures from dozens to zero:
- `6e8dcba8` focus rings: an outset ring paints outside the border box, so the element capture was blind to it and scored a visible ring 1.000. Fixed by capturing the ring's padded band.
- `d7577c01` muted copy: `#6b716d` on the contact band `#ece7dc` was 4.047. Muted is now proved against the darkest recurring light band, guarded so a dark page keeps the page-surface pairing.
- `eaabc480` brand text: `#b9522a` on `#f7f5ee` was 4.474. Same treatment, now 5.383 there and 4.546 at worst across the light bands.

### Transport moved to OpenRouter

OpenCode Go returned `GoUsageLimitError` with `limitName: monthly` on a direct probe, and every launch attempt 429ed. The identical pinned model (`deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`) answers 200 on OpenRouter, so the documented manual rollback was applied: `CREATIVE_EXPERIENCE_PROVIDER` and `SITE_COPY_PROVIDER` are now `openrouter`. This unblocked intake, reference analysis and authoring.

### Remaining

- Creative authoring still fails on this intake: `Candidate route-01 image source must use a sealed image content token` after five experience attempts. The pack fallback covered delivery, so the preview is a pack render, not a creative one.
- Delivery step previously failed after a successful send because a skipped label made `gh pr edit --remove-label` exit non-zero. Fixed at `fff3a4d9`.
- Reported rate is unchanged at 12/100 overall, creative 4/77. The delivered preview is one real pass; the 20-intake cohort and the 18/20 measurement are still outstanding.
